title: Idle Watcher. Devlog.
author: Altruistic_Cat5688
selftext:
Disclaimer: The game is coded by Claude. Art concepted by human and then iterated by Codex.   


My lovely bears!

Today I want to show you a slightly improved version of the city view.

It didn’t happen without a fight with Claude though.

I wanted to add a particle system to the game for WebGL. Supposedly no problem - I had it after about 10 minutes, but it didn’t work - there were no particles visible.

After an hour we finally got to the point where the particles were visible. Every time I told Claude that I still couldn’t see any particles, he found another reason why they weren’t working - and this time it was 100% definitely the correct one.

Then we moved on to working on a tool that was supposed to let me set up particles in the scene. This is where hell started, because for some reason the particles I was setting up were not visible.

It turned out that there was actually a whole cascade of problems:

* for some reason Claude decided that particles should only render on the bottom half of the screen
* then he ignored my settings from the tool
* the longest part was getting the emitters positioned correctly on the screen so they actually matched the points visible on the screen. Claude had problems converting the position I set into where the particles should actually be rendered

Once we managed to solve the problems above, we went through a few iterations of the tool and the particles themselves so they would finally let me achieve the effect I wanted.

You can download the game for free from Discord. Any feedback is very welcome and I add everyone to the credits.
